description_en: Associates an SSL certificate with a forwarding rule of a website service
description_zh: 为网站业务转发规则关联SSL证书
name: AssociateWebCert

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The certificate ID.
If you specify the certificate ID, you do not need to specify CertName, Cert, or Key. This parameter cannot be used together with CertIdentifier
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
传入证书ID后，无需传入CertName、Cert和Key。不能与CertIdentifier同时传入
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate name. 

The name of the certificate to associate. This parameter must be used together with Cert and Key
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称。 

要关联的证书名称。该参数必须与Cert和Key一同使用
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The public key of the certificate to associate. This parameter must be used together with CertName and Key. 

If you specify CertName, Cert, and Key, you do not need to specify CertId
parameters.help_zh:
要关联的证书公钥。该参数必须与CertName和Key一同使用。 

传入CertName、Cert和Key后，无需传入CertId
parameters.name: cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the certificate to associate. This parameter must be used together with CertName and Cert. 

If you specify CertName, Cert, and Key, you do not need to specify CertId
parameters.help_zh:
要关联的证书私钥。该参数必须与CertName和Cert一同使用。 

传入CertName、Cert和Key后，无需传入CertId
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The global certificate ID, which is in the format of certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is 123, set CertIdentifier to "123-cn-hangzhou".
This parameter cannot be used together with CertId
parameters.help_zh:
全局证书ID，证书ID+"-cn-hangzhou"。如果证书ID=123，则CertIdentifier=“123-cn-hangzhou”。
不能与CertId同时传入
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The region where the certificate is stored. Valid values: cn-hangzhou and ap-southeast-1. Default value: cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: cert_region

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
